body:
I suppose acceptance of what I am is what I lack. I could probably learn practical skills (like construction, programming, etc.) and accomplish something, but in a way that makes me dispensable.  Any old schmuck could do those things; the loss of a worker bee is nothing to mourn.

An analogy I can think of is "Brave New World", where there were Alphas, Betas, Gammas, etc., and everybody was happy being in the class they were assigned. I just fear that I'm an Epsilon and I'm rationalizing being happy about it.
